clearedSpotChecks.check: Whether a PoolManager call to a MegaETH system contract address can be answered by an interceptor instead of the deployed code (mega-evm v1.7.4 intercept.rs, selectors 66cdf82f, 846365d5, c62e8daf, 143d63fd, 15f95280, 02be4d84).
clearedSpotChecks.note: intercept.rs at mega-evm@1.7.4 admits a call only when target_address equals the system address and the first four bytes of calldata equal the interceptor selector (lines 185, 222-223, 305-312, 430-451, 497-505); peek_selector returns None for calldata shorter than four bytes (lines 45-65), so an empty native take is never intercepted. I computed the selectors with tools/opdiff/evm.py keccak: sendHint(bytes32,bytes)=66cdf82f, keylessDeploy(bytes,uint256)=846365d5, disableVolatileDataAccess()=c62e8daf, enableVolatileDataAccess()=143d63fd, isVolatileDataAccessDisabled()=15f95280, remainingComputeGas()=02be4d84, plus keylessDeploy(bytes,uint64)=6ecdbbac as a variant. eth_getCode of 0xacb7e78f...d38e on mainnet.megaeth.com returned 24,009 bytes; none of the seven hex strings occurs at any nibble offset, while a9059cbb occurs twice and 70a08231 once. The outgoing calls of the PoolManager are Currency.sol:48 (empty calldata), Currency.sol:60/73 (transfer selector), Currency.sol:94 (balanceOf) and Hooks.sol:134 (IHooks selectors). The clearance holds.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Rex4 per-call-frame budgets: a frame that exceeds its local budget reverts with MegaLimitExceeded while the parent continues.
clearedSpotChecks.note: docs.megaeth.com/spec/network-upgrades/rex4.md lines 31-35 state the 98/100 share and that the parent may continue after a frame-local revert. The source has exactly three low-level calls (grep over src/ for call(, try, staticcall: Currency.sol:48, Currency.sol:73, Hooks.sol:134) and each one reverts the whole frame on failure: Currency.sol:51-53, Currency.sol:82-86 and Hooks.sol:137 call CustomRevert.bubbleUpAndRevertWith. There is no try statement in src/. balanceOf and unlockCallback are high-level calls that revert on failure. A frame-local exceed below the PoolManager therefore unwinds the unlock and its deltas; it cannot leave a credit or a payout behind. The same page, lines 139-143, confirms the 23,000 gas storage stipend is burned on return and does not change the value sent, which matches the companion cleared item.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Rerun of the general battery (99,985 vectors) and the targeted set (85,544 vectors) on rpc.monad.xyz at Monad/0.16.7 and mainnet.megaeth.com at mega-reth/v2.3.1-4499c42.
clearedSpotChecks.note: out/battery.json and out/targeted.json record ran equal to vectors and zero mismatches and errors for both chain ids. I ran an independent 14-vector program by eth_call with a code override at 0x...0c0ffe on both endpoints (web3_clientVersion Monad/0.16.7 and mega-reth/v2.3.1-4499c42@mnet-ash-rpc-2): MULMOD(M,M,M-1), MULMOD with a 2^128-159 modulus, ADDMOD(M,M-2,M), SDIV(-2^255,-1), SMOD(-7,3), DIV by zero, SIGNEXTEND(0,0x80), SAR by 255 and 300 of 2^255, SHL by 256, SHR by 255, BYTE 31, EXP(3,255) and SLT(-2^255,0). All 14 words equal the specification on both. Monad answered HTTP 429 once before the run. This speaks for Monad's interpreter only (the RPC executor is InterpreterOnly), which the unit states and which F-130 already records. I also confirmed the related Rex1 dating: the overview page gives Rex1 mainnet activation 1766282400, eth_getCode of the PoolManager is empty at block 7,009,652 and present at 7,009,653, and block 0x6af575 has timestamp 1769806664.
